{{Quote|Ten snubfighters against sixty TIEs and an ImpStar? That would be suicide.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 30">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 30|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 30]]</ref>}}
The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] launched an '''undercover operation on Axxila''' to meet with [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]. However, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces attacked [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]] in order to capture [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].

==Background==
{{Quote|Kidnapped from here? I thought this palace was supposed to be secure.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="XWRS28" />}}
Several months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] impersonated by [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] members were in a [[Operation on Eiattu|reception]] on [[Eiattu 6]], when agents of [[Leonia Tavira]], knocked out and captured Winter and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], bringing them to their boss on [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]].

Han Solo and [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] identified a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] involved, [[Rayt (smuggler)|Rayt]], and caught him on the [[StarForge Station]]. He revealed them he transferred Winter and Tycho for the [[Kavil's Corsairs]] to Axxila. Han Solo and Rogue Squadron immediately departed to the planet.

==Leia's mission to Axxila==
{{Quote|In return for my life and certain other concessions, I shall leave Imperial Center as undefended as Caamas.|[[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]|<ref name="XWRS29">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 29|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 29]]</ref>}}
Under the cover of the meeting on Eiattu, the real [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia met with [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] on Axxila. In exchange for his life, along with ten worlds for himself and fifteen worlds for four friends, Pestage offered to leave [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] virtually undefended from attack. He also arranged for his agent [[Kavil]] to arrange the release of Winter and Tycho from Tavira.

==The battle==
{{Quote|People of Axxila, I am Admiral Krennel of the ''Reckoning''. You harbor traitors to the Empire. You are scum who have long festered without proper discipline. Give me the traitors and I will refrain from visiting upon you the retribution you most assuredly deserve.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 30" />}}
Yet Tycho and Winter managed to escape on their own, breaking out of their separate cells, fighting past the guards, stealing a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]], and out-flying the pursuit offered up by Kavil's corsairs. Fortunately, they managed to send out a distress call, and Rogue Squadron and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] cleared the way back to base for Tycho and Winter.

[[File:AT3_directive.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] gives an [[AT3 Directive]].]]
However, an Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Reckoning (Imperial II-class)|''Reckoning'']], arrived in the system at the same time. The ship under command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]] was sent by [[Ysanne Isard]] to capture Leia. After have recovered Pestage, the Admiral launched his [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] on the planet and began [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. The New Republic agents situation was critical when Krennel was stopped by an [[AT3 Directive]] issued by Soontir Fel. Delak Krennel was forced to obey at the behest of Sate Pestage and left the system.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Pestage's treason will stop now.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Paltr Carvin]]|<ref name="XWRS32" />}}
When Pestage returned to Coruscant, he confronted Isard and claimed not to have known Fel had defected, shifting the blame onto her for not informing him. When Isard accused him of meeting with Leia Organa, he implicitly denied it and reminded her that she had no proof.

Isard was not to be thwarted, however. She went before the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Tribunal]] and accused Pestage of collaborating with the New Republic. She claimed to have proof of this from confidential sources, and reminded the Tribunal that Pestage had allowed Leia Organa to escape from Axxila, had [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|lost Brentaal]], and informed them that he planned to turn over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to the New Republic. The Tribunal agreed with her, charged Pestage with [[Treason/Legends|treason]], and issued an order for his arrest.<ref name="XWRS32" />
